gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an overclaim that directional motion results characterize the tangent-space distribution or determine when inter-mode probability appears. ISSUE-004 concerns unsupported separate normal/tangent training-loss floors and monotonicity; it does not diagnose the missing distributional or emergence characterization.

The gold issue is the unsupported interpretation of early noisy experimental points as a normal-distance stage, specifically because eigengaps collapse and no reliability threshold is checked. ISSUE-001 concerns proving or assuming global ridge manifold and spectral-gap structure for a formal proposition, not validating the experimental stage interpretation.

The gold issue concerns the numerical estimator accepting a normal-score stationary point without verifying the ridge curvature condition. ISSUE-001 concerns unsupported formal manifold and reach assumptions; it does not identify the estimator's failure to certify lambda_{d*+1}<=-beta or the resulting wrong-set distance.

The gold issue is the omitted product-rule derivative of the eigenvector field in the Newton Jacobian for F(y)=E(y)^T grad log p(y). ISSUE-001 addresses missing assumptions for ridge geometry and projection regularity, not the specific Newton differentiation and solver formula.

The gold issue concerns applying the spectral inverse at unrestricted estimator inputs without a nonzero-eigenvalue or conditioning safeguard. ISSUE-001 concerns establishing ridge manifold and reach assumptions under the data model; it does not diagnose the inverse solve's domain or conditioning contract.
